Set next to the picturesque Vondelpark, in the heart of the city, the 396-room Amsterdam Marriott is celebrated for its proximity to significant landmarks such as the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, exclusive shopping, vibrant nightlife and high-end restaurants. Opened in 1975 as the first Marriott in Europe, the hotel blends a prime location with contemporary interiors, offering an ideal address for exploring Amsterdam. The hotel also features 11 flexible meeting and event spaces with natural daylight, including our Grand Ballroom and studios.

Guests can enjoy premium dining at Midtown Grill, one of Amsterdam's top steak restaurants, as well as Bar TWLV, our cosmopolitan bar offering globally inspired dishes, creative cocktails and a day-to-night atmosphere. What are my responsibilities?For the position of security agent, you work with our security department. You patrol all areas of the property, and report and investigate incidents and accidents. Besides this, you also help other departments, like the concierge, valet parking, housekeeping, and assist with technical requests at night.  What makes you the perfect fit?You are strongly hospitality minded, representative and flexible. You like to work in teams, but on the other hand, you can also work alone. You have strong social skills and an eye for detail. But most importantly, you are willing to work at night, and during holidays (Christmas, New Year's Eve, Etc.)To be eligible for this position you…
• Are a certified first aid officer (BHV)
• Have received ABM / Beveiliger 2 level
• Have a driver's license
• Have worked within the hospitality industry before
• You have a good level of English and Dutch
• Have preferably 2 years' experience within security

jobs.description:
Radisson Hotel & Suites Amsterdam South has 227 suites and rooms and opened in April 2021. We want to appeal to both transient and longer-staying travellers visiting the Dutch capital. Each of the studio's, one-bed and two-bed apartments has its own fully equipped kitchen. It is up to us to make our guest feel at home with our family of associates! All rooms are suites with more living and working space than you would find in an any other hotel room.

Your eye-for-detail makes sure that our hotel is spotless! Your genuine focus on hygiene and cleaning up ensures that the environment meets the highest requirements. Our Room / Public Attendants are at the heart of what we do!
